# ShopShot

> ShopShot turns one product photo into up to 10 marketplace-ready product images (white-background hero, lifestyle, flat-lay, in-use, size reference, detail and multi-angle shots) in about 25 seconds, sized for eBay, Amazon, Etsy, Depop, Shopify, Vinted and social media. Built for small online sellers. UK-based.

- Each image costs one credit; users choose which shots to make.
- Standard quality uses Google's gemini-2.5-flash-image model; Pro quality uses gemini-3-pro-image-preview.
- Free account: 6 Standard and 2 Pro credits at signup, then 4 Standard credits every Monday for the first 4 weeks. No card required.
- Paid plans: Starter, Standard and Pro, monthly or annual, plus one-off credit packs. Current prices: https://www.shopshot.co.uk/pricing
- Free background remover, no account needed: https://www.shopshot.co.uk/tools/remove-background
